reviewType: Independent fresh paired static likeness; reviewer did not author either model
authority: Original approved low-poly hero; corrected World/Explorer originals supporting and approximate
promotion: Neither passes; retain predecessor as better likeness of this pair, not a runtime admission
historicalRatings: Not reused or reconciled into these scores. Current plan contains historical ratings; these fresh scores are based on inspected raw pair.

reasons.silhouetteProportions: Broad shoulders, long hanging hands, antler crown and bent wide legs identify the guardian. Hands remain segmented slab hooks, lower-leg/stone anchoring narrow, side torso reads as a smooth dark oval rather than layered root mass.
reasons.faceExpression: Thin cyan eye slits and long pointed angular mask retain the stern original expression. Mask is still mechanical, symmetrical and darker than the warm pale tapered original.
reasons.definingDetails: Root clasps visibly encircle and partially overlap the cyan core, closer to the authoritative hero. Canopy remains sparse, repeated triangular leaf groups and blocky stone toes simplify the organic layering.
reasons.facetStyle: Readable low-poly bark/stone/foliage categories; long extruded angular bands and regular leaf wedges remain more assembled and less sculpted than the original.

reasons.silhouetteProportions: Slightly tighter hanging-arm spread, wider ankle roots and larger canopy islands improve cohesion. Same main wide shoulder-to-arm scaffolding, narrow lower legs and broad dark back remain; no major mass recovery.
reasons.faceExpression: Larger cyan quadrilateral panels increase visibility but dilute the original narrow predatory slit expression, producing a mask/robot appearance. Longer central face ridge does not offset this identity regression.
reasons.definingDetails: Deeper core seating and simpler long root paths reduce clutter, but removing encircling ribs/clasps exposes a plain crystal pendant and removes a defining original feature. Broader leaf clusters improve hierarchy but do not restore dense shoulder/nape growth.
reasons.facetStyle: More continuous brown material strips and grouped canopy are modest improvements. Large lime polygon caps, uniform hanging triangles and long angular plank surfaces still dominate.
